sources.entry: gfxCardStatus - Monitor graphics card usage and battery impact. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: gfxCardStatus
summary.one_liner: gfxCardStatus is a menu bar app for OS X that shows which apps are using the power-hungry discrete GPU on dual-GPU MacBook Pros and lets you switch between integrated and discrete graphics.
use_cases: Find which apps are draining MacBook battery by using the discrete GPU
Force a dual-GPU MacBook Pro to use only the integrated GPU
Force a dual-GPU MacBook Pro to use only the discrete GPU
Get notified when the MacBook switches graphics cards
Check which GPU is currently active from the menu bar
summary.what_it_does: gfxCardStatus sits in the OS X menu bar and shows which GPU is active, with an 'i' icon for integrated and a 'd' icon for discrete. Its Dependencies list shows which apps are turning on the discrete GPU when the menu is opened. Users can manually force Integrated Only or Discrete Only mode. It can send Growl or Notification Center alerts when the GPU changes. The page says it is localized in more than 20 languages.
notable: Dependencies list shows which apps are turning on the discrete GPU
Manual Integrated Only or Discrete Only mode
caveats: Requires OS X Mavericks (10.9) or newer
Only works on 2010-or-newer dual-GPU MacBook Pro models (15", 16", 17")
